game.intro: Night one of the show! The moon is brand new, the confetti cannon is loaded, and Saturn has ironed his judging robe.
game.question: A tiny door appears in your kitchen wall overnight. What do you hope is behind it?
options: A staircase down to the sea

game.intro: Toques are on the run tonight and the camera is suspicious of everything woolly. Get close. Closer. Rude-close.
game.prompt: Something knitted, crocheted or woven. Zoom until it looks like a satellite map of a strange country.

game.intro: The kettle has been whispering again. Tonight, facts are banned from the studio. Saturn will sort the wreckage.
game.question: Why does a kettle whistle when the water boils?

game.intro: The moon just moved into Nancy's spare room and it is making noise up there. Contestants, warm up your mouths.
game.prompt: The sound of someone settling into a creaky old house at night: floorboard, radiator, door, your call.

game.intro: Two blue mittens, two towns, one hand each. Don't even scream. The newsroom has stopped the presses.
game.headline: SINGLE BLUE MITTEN FOUND ___, EXPERTS REFUSE TO COMMENT

game.intro: Inventors, put down your soldering irons. Tonight we count tiny coloured squares and nobody goes over.
game.question: A standard 3x3 twisty puzzle cube has how many coloured stickers in total?

game.intro: The wind is taking attendance and it has a stopwatch. Three pairs. Ten seconds each. No dithering, cowards welcome.
Perfect-half day. Saturn split his sandwich with a ruler. You only have to split your opinions.
game.question: You must share one thing exactly 50/50 with a stranger for a year. Which do you pick?

game.intro: Fog letters are drifting across the water tonight. Our camera has fogged up too. On purpose. Mostly.
game.prompt: Something that glows or gives off light, shot so close the other person can't tell lamp from candle from fridge.

game.intro: Cozy night, so the studio dimmed the lights and lost all its facts in the couch cushions. Answer wrong. Answer comfy.
game.question: What is a postcard actually for?

game.intro: The moon knocked on the Tiger's door tonight. Mars answered. It was loud. Your turn to be loud.
game.prompt: A big cat waking up from a nap and finding out dinner is late.

game.intro: Three-eleven struck twice today and the studio clock is still shaking. DES. Fingers on the tiny pictures, please.
game.prompt: A famous coincidence or happy surprise from history, a story or your own life. Emoji only.

game.intro: The jar lid won the morning. Tonight you win it back by lying, but only once. Saturn knows. Saturn always knows.
game.prompt: Three things you opened, unwrapped or unscrewed this week. One is a fib.

game.intro: Recharge eve! The moon is nearly full and buzzing like a fridge. Answer before it hums at you.
FULL MOON RECHARGE. Ruby and onyx are glowing on the set. The crew is in sunglasses. Pick wisely.
game.question: If your stone could gain one tiny superpower overnight, which would you want it to have?
options: Hums when they think of you
Glows when it's going to snow
Remembers every story told near it

game.intro: Gemini moon: two of everything, including two cameras, both pointed far too close. Who asked? We asked.
game.prompt: Anything that comes in a pair: shoes, earrings, salt and pepper, chopsticks. Show only one, very close.

game.intro: The cabin is hogging every blanket in the building, so the facts froze solid. Thaw something wrong for Saturn.
game.question: Why do we pull blankets up over our feet even when the room is warm?

game.intro: The casserole dish came home and the kitchen threw it a party. Grab a mic. Grab a spoon. Make noise.
game.prompt: A busy kitchen in one sound: a pot lid, a sizzle, a drawer of cutlery, a timer going off.

game.intro: A golden scarf showed up twice in one day. Don't even scream. The gossip desk is beside itself with glee.
game.headline: GOLDEN SCARF SPOTTED ___, WITNESSES DEMAND AN ENCORE

game.intro: November takes a bow and exits. Before the curtain drops, Saturn wants a number. A board-game number.
game.question: How many squares are on a standard chessboard?

game.intro: Last night of November. The drawers are labelled, the moon is half-lit, and the buzzer is twitchy. Go.
